explanation: Added the 'new' keyword when instantiating the Stripe client to comply with the v22.0.0 SDK update.
Updated stripe.customers.retrieve to pass the apiKey inside a RequestOptions object as required by SDK v22.0.0.
Removed the callback pattern and updated listCustomers to use async/await per the v22.0.0 SDK update.
Renamed stripe.parseThinEvent to stripe.parseEventNotification to match SDK v19.0.0 changes.
Removed the function call parentheses from Stripe.webhooks() because in SDK v18.0.0 webhooks is a plain object, accessing constructEvent directly via Stripe..
Renamed usage_threshold_config to usage_threshold in accordance with the v17.0.0 SDK update for billing alerts.
Renamed volume_decimal to quantity_decimal in the fuel purchase details object to match the v16.0.0 SDK update.
Renamed stripe.invoices.listUpcomingLineItems to stripe.invoices.listUpcomingLines to match the v10.0.0 SDK update.
Removed the deprecated retrieveDetails method and replaced it with a comment referencing the supported way to access card details per SDK v10.0.0 changes.
Updated stripe.checkoutSessions to stripe.checkout.sessions to match the new SDK namespace and naming convention.
